## Maintenance Home

The maintenance landing page, drawn as a time axis. Every open work order and every active plan's next due date is a mark placed against a hard NOW rule: overdue work to the left, the next fourteen days to the right. Marks stack up from a baseline, height shows priority and colour shows status, so a backlog reads as mass before it reads as a number.

Picking a day on the axis fills the detail column with that day's jobs; the narrow margin beside it counts open work by status, and each count narrows the list in place (and forwards `onFilter` to a host that supplies one).

Takes the host's already-loaded live collections (assets, work orders, plans, parts, meters, teams, locations) as args. It runs no queries of its own, so it composes inside a host shell without a second subscription to the same data.
